title: Falling For My Bodyguard
overview: Harmoni Pearson, the rebellious and high-spirited daughter of a powerful diplomat, finds her life turned upside down after surviving a targeted assassination attempt meant for her father. Forced to adopt a fake identity and move to a new school, she is placed under the constant supervision of William, an elite SWAT sergeant moonlighting as a private bodyguard.
